purpose: Supplement the fixed R165 predicate intervention with well-posed actual left/right queries on a few of the same output-blinded images. R165 numbers and original panel remain separate.
selection: Use five adjudicable scenes from the output-blind image panel, one per chosen frame, all eligible source directions. Visual descriptions and separate identity answers are frozen before any predictions of these queries. This is a constructed stress test, independent of R167 per-case results and unsuitable for estimating population accuracy.
intervention: Parse matching controlled left/right clauses over identical entity phrases. Neutralize the explicit direction for the common native 3EED and R76/R91 forward, with the two text spans assigned explicitly. Pass the parsed sign separately to the already locked R167 readout. Use identical geometry, candidate bank, unaries and relationship scoring for both clauses and all matched arms. The neutral forward supplies native proposals; the same image's already sealed supplemental R166 regions can enter the shared bank. The neutral probability uses the existing R76/R91 readout with role routing and no direction-specific predicate tokens.
review: Score both interventions against separately frozen visual labels. Verify common reference and opposite sides from annotation calibration, report each arm's full paired outcomes for all authored pairs. No source or target training and no FINAL access. This test measures the explicit predicate path.
